# 2 Chronicles 29 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Chronicles 29 (36 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 6

---

## V.2
- **EMET:** "And-he-did the-right in-eyes-of YHWH according-to-all that did David his-father."
- **LOGOS:** "And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, according to all that David his father had done."
- **PNEUMA:** "He did what was right in the LORD's eyes, just as his ancestor David had done."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.8
- **EMET:** "And-there-was wrath-of YHWH upon Judah and-Jerusalem and-He-gave-them for-horror for-astonishment and-for-hissing as-you are-seeing with-your-eyes."
- **LOGOS:** "Therefore the wrath of the LORD came on Judah and Jerusalem, and He has made them an object of horror, of astonishment, and of hissing, as you see wit"
- **PNEUMA:** "That is why the LORD's wrath fell on Judah and Jerusalem. He made them an object of dread, horror, and scorn, as you can see with your own eyes."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.9
- **EMET:** "And-behold fell our-fathers by-the-sword and-our-sons and-our-daughters and-our-wives are-in captivity for-this."
- **LOGOS:** "For behold, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this."
- **PNEUMA:** "This is why our ancestors have fallen by the sword, and our sons, daughters, and wives have been taken captive."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.16
- **EMET:** "And-they-came the-priests inside house-of YHWH to-purify and-they-brought-out all the-uncleanness that they-found in-temple-of YHWH to-court-of house-"
- **LOGOS:** "The priests went into the inner part of the house of the LORD to cleanse it, and they brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of"
- **PNEUMA:** "The priests entered the inner part of the LORD's temple to purify it. They brought out to the temple courtyard everything unclean they found inside. T"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.29
- **EMET:** "And-as-finishing to-offer they-bowed the-king and-all the-found with-him and-they-worshiped."
- **LOGOS:** "When the offering was finished, the king and all who were present with him bowed themselves and worshiped."
- **PNEUMA:** "When the offerings were complete, the king and everyone present with him knelt down and worshiped."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.33
- **EMET:** "And-the-consecrated-things cattle six-hundred and-sheep three-thousand."
- **LOGOS:** "And the consecrated offerings were 600 bulls and 3,000 sheep."
- **PNEUMA:** "The animals consecrated as sacrifices totaled 600 bulls and 3,000 sheep and goats."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

*— SOPHIA*
